remarks: Conveniently (and centrally) located near downtown Stamford in the beautiful, residential, Westover section of Stamford. This location uniquely affords convenience for commuters, a quiet and private neighborhood setting and close to downtown Stamford. Just a few minute drive (less than three miles) to the Stamford train station, I-95 as well as the Merritt Parkway and nestled in a tranquil neighborhood of larger homes.  Recently updated home featuring four bedrooms, two bathrooms, hardwood floors, tiled baths, gas cooking, central air, wood-burning fireplace, washer/dryer and two-car automatic garage. Energy efficient home is well insulated and features Andersen windows and efficient natural gas heating. Home sits on a private 1/2 + acre and features a fenced garden (for any prospective gardeners). Additionally, one of the four bedrooms and one of the two bathrooms are located on the lower floor and would work well as an au pair or guest space.  Excellent credit and long term lease preferred.
